name: What permits are required for plumbing changes during a remodel in the East Bay?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for plumbing changes during a remodel in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing changes during a remodel in the East Bay, including cities like Berkeley, Oakland, and Albany, typically require permits from the local building department. These permits ensure that all work complies with current plumbing codes and safety standards. Our team at Frasheski Construction handles the permit application process, which includes submitting detailed plans for review and arranging for necessary inspections at various stages of the plumbing installation, streamlining this critical step for homeowners.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing changes in East Bay remodels require permits from the local building department to ensure code compliance. Our team manages this process.
